notes.title: Patch 1.0.9
notes.content:
Fixed:
- Missing lines after some dice rolls
- Missing character skins in the gallery
- Camera zoom and movement
- Screen resolution problems

notes.title: Update №2
notes.content:
- Added controller support 
- Fixed dice rolls being skipped under certain conditions
- Volume settings now are applying while you change them
- Fixed reset progress function, now it shouldn't reset resolution and language settings
- Improved Gallery UI
- Fixed missing and doubling UI sounds

notes.title: 1st Day Update
notes.content:
- Fixed save and load bug
- Optimized sound design in dialogues
- Added item sounds
- Fixed achievements display in the gallery
- Added Mac version (if the game doesn't start, check the game files via Steam library)

notes.title: Out fantasy tale just released!
notes.content:
Our second big VN is out today, a kinky fantasy eroge inspired by classic tabletop roleplaying games! 

Bright fantasy world, many ways to resolve each event and of course lots of hot sex scenes await you in EmyLiveShow: Dragon & Mistresses Tale 🔥

Release Sale 30% for the first week!

Known Issues for the Hotfix: 
- Load Game in the pause menu loads Autosave instead of the selected slot (if you've encountered this situation, use Load Game in the main menu)
- Music volume resets after changing settings in the pause menu
- Minor UI issues
